address: The Ritz-Carlton Abu Dhabi, Grand Canal, Khor Al Maqt'a, Abu Dhabi
bio: Southeast Asian dishes lead the way at this restaurant within The Ritz-Carlton hotel. All dishes are prepared with equal care – the Szechuan chilli lamb loin will certainly get your taste buds excited – but it’s the wok dishes that are their speciality. Order dishes like wok-fried scallops and butter prawns, then watch the chefs working dexterously and skilfully behind the glass screens. The friendly team run the place well and service is smooth and professional.
